messages.content: 如何在簡單模式的第7關和困難模式的第3關保存遊戲進度？

function.name: game_save_progress
function.description: Save the current state of a player's game, given the stage, level and game mode. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

stage.description: The current stage in the game the player has reached.

mode.description: The game mode. Available modes are easy or hard.

Or maybe we can combine? The function signature: game_save_progress takes an object with stage (number), mode ("easy"|"hard"), level optional string default "user". So we need to call it twice: once with stage=7, mode="easy", level unspecified; second with stage=3, mode="hard". The user didn't specify level, so default "user". So we should call the function twice. According to guidelines, we should call the function via the "functions" tool. We'll produce two calls. The response should include the function calls.
